fields.title: Calculate Load
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Product: 400k active daily, 1.6 sessions per person, 18 requests per session, peak coefficient 4.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: A newsletter is planned for the entire database, expected conversion is 12% in the first hour. How much will be added to the peak?
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: What product lever will reduce this spike?
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 400,000 x 1.6 x 18 = 11.5M per day, ~133 average RPS, ~530 at peak. Newsletter: 48k conversions per hour, but uneven — half in the first 10 minutes, which is ~40 sessions per second x 18 requests ≈ 700 additional RPS, more than a double increase. Lever — send in waves over 3 hours, the spike drops about sixfold with the same result.
